data.name: Halima
data.detailed_description:
Enter a dream world shaped by jinn, memory, and forgotten rituals.

Halima is a story-rich adventure set inside surreal, claymation-inspired dreamscapes. You play as Halima, a young priestess who journeys into the dream world to seek answers for her people, only to become trapped within its shifting layers.

To escape, Halima must learn how the dream speaks. Symbols repeat. Paths fold back on themselves. Ancient forces watch from the dark. As she explores deeper, the world begins to reveal the hidden truths buried beneath its beauty.

Explore a Layered Dream World

Move and platform through strange desert dreamscapes, ritual spaces, ruined structures, and symbolic environments where every object, pattern, and creature carries meaning.

Solve Puzzles Written Into the Dream

Use traversal, observation, and environmental puzzle-solving to read the dream’s hidden logic. At first, you follow its patterns. Later, you learn how to disrupt them.

Evade the Nightmare Jinn

Tense chase sequences and dream-born threats interrupt the quiet, forcing Halima to run, hide, and survive moments where the dream turns against her.

Uncover Memories, Artifacts, and Hidden Truths

Speak with cryptic characters, discover artifacts, and piece together fragments of lore through Halima’s Dream Journal.

A Handcrafted Claymation-Inspired World

Halima is built around a tactile visual language of clay, fabric, sand, paper, metal, and handmade surfaces, giving the dream world a strange physical presence.

A Focused Premium Journey

Designed as a complete, story-driven experience, Halima blends atmospheric exploration, symbolic puzzles, platforming, and mythic storytelling into a polished single-player adventure.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD FX-8350 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 / AMD Radeon R9 380, 2GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • VR Support: None
  • Additional Notes: Estimated requirements for 1080p / 30 FPS on Low settings. Final requirements may change after optimization.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or equivalent
  • Memory: 16384 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580, 4GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 15000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • VR Support: None
  • Additional Notes: Estimated requirements for 1080p / 60 FPS on High settings. Final requirements will be confirmed after Vertical Slice profiling and optimization.
